facet1_choice: use the existing fired population as-is
facet1_note: The brief allows either. Re-running the gate causally against all of D1 is not a small lift -- it means executing or re-implementing epg_replay.py's Hawkes refit over ~15,763 events. The existing population is on disk with full per-trade records.

coverage_steps.note: outside-D1 events are carried in the artifact, flagged, not dropped. R0-T0b resolved them: warrants, preferreds, fund products, and in-scope-class events flagged flag_trades_mom_outlier.

coverage_steps.step: with a tick-derived prior close (move_at computable)
with a resolvable filtered/ event folder (tick window readable)
EVALUABLE (scorable + prior close, so move_at is defined too)

coverage_against_D1.statement: This build runs on 997 of 15763 D1 events (6.32%). It is NOT a measurement over D1. The population is the val-split slice the gate was actually run on: dates 2023-11-17 to 2024-07-22.

B_e_divisor_check.reading: 117 = 3 sessions x 39 ten-minute blocks in a 6.5-hour RTH session, so B_e is mean dollar volume per 10-minute RTH block over 3 prior sessions.

exit_mix_first_window.note: the brief specifies window-close exit; natural_exit_* is that exit. The LULD rows are carried, not dropped.
